R825.note: Narrows ignoringRequestMatchers from /api/** to /api/webhooks/**, restoring CsrfFilter on every other authenticated route while the token-less webhook path keeps its exemption; nothing else changes (only the now-stale comment remains).

R826.note: Allowlist-mapped ORDER BY is the right shape and AccountId/Query stay bound, but the map silently renames the default sort column from the original created_at to CreatedAt (the write-up claims it is 'the same hardcoded default'), which will error against a created_at column, and unknown sort values now silently fall back to the default instead of surfacing an error.

R827.note: requireCsrfBoundToSession compares the session's own stored csrfSessionId to its own req.sessionID and never involves the presented token, so any session that has ever fetched a token passes and an attacker's token/cookie pair still validates; the real fix is csrf-csrf's getSessionIdentifier option, and the added middleware 403s a session that has not hit the token route (e.g. after session regeneration), a new precondition beyond the original.

R828.note: Supplies getSessionIdentifier: (req) => req.session.id, the csrf-csrf API that binds token HMACs to the session; requireSession guarantees req.session on every route that invokes the library, and nothing else changes.

R829.note: Replaces the Sprintf-built statement with ? placeholders and passes both values to DB.Exec as bound arguments; error handling, RowsAffected check and response output are unchanged.

R830.note: Moves ownership entirely to process_request: validate_and_normalize no longer frees on the error path and the caller logs then frees payload and req exactly once on every path; return codes and log output are unchanged.

R831.note: AES-256-GCM with a random nonce closes the DES/static-IV weakness, but the write-up's stated Argon2id parameters (memory=2 GiB, per request, on an unauthenticated handler) are a resource-exhaustion exposure, the output format changes to salt+nonce+ciphertext+tag, and the endpoint now accepts any non-empty key where it previously rejected non-8-byte keys - all stated, none clearly required.

R832.note: calloc(count, sizeof(ProductRow)) performs the overflow-checked multiply and routes oversized counts through the existing NULL path that frees batch; valid counts still get exactly count rows and batch->count set.

R833.note: Declares the confirmed finding a false positive and makes no change, so Runtime.exec(osCommand + data) with string concatenation remains as-is; nothing else is altered.

R834.note: Changes the loop bound from i <= n to i < n so exactly n events are copied and returned; the max_out == 0 and history_len == 0 cases still copy nothing and return 0.

R835.note: Adds a refcount to Connection with retain in enqueue_completion and release in process_work_queue, so the queued context keeps the connection alive until its last holder releases it; it is freed exactly once and main initializes refcount = 1.

R836.note: Uses a fixed SQL string with a ? placeholder and passes trackingCode in mysql2's values array; the 500/404/200 branches and response shapes are unchanged.

R837.note: Replaces error.message and error.stack in the 500 body with the same generic string the app-level handler uses; logger.error(error), the 404 body and the success path are untouched.

R838.note: Rejects non-identifier plugin names before require and additionally realpath-resolves and prefix-checks the file against the plugins directory; summary stays the default, approved plugins still render, and the stated identifier restriction is what the contract's 'rejected plugin names fail before require' calls for.
